How this works

  • This is Part 2 of 2. Days 5 to 8. Do Part 1 first if you have not.
  • Press the glowing button. Only one button works at a time, so there is nothing to hunt for and nothing to get wrong.
  • Then watch, and read the box underneath. The demo talks while it moves, and tells you what it meant the moment it stops.
  • Questions come last. Only your first try counts. Retry all you like.
  • Each level ends at your robot. Go and run it.

At the end you get your miss list. Bring it to the coach.
